name: Opago API Documentation
description:
Welcome to the **Opago API Documentation**.
Please review the following authentication and authorization rules:
1. To register and obtain login credentials, contact: **antanas@cityrelay.com**
2. Use the `**/login**` endpoint to retrieve your **access_token** and **refresh_token**.
3. If your **access_token** has expired, retrieve a new one using the `**/refresh**` endpoint.
4. For all endpoints (except `**/login**`), include your **access_token** in the Authorization header.
5. Use the format: `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}`
This API is designed to provide secure and streamlined integration with the Opago platform.
